goal: Editable, coloured CAD of the launch pad scene registered to the photo
geometry_plan: Decompose: rocket (revolved), strongback (box), launch mount and pad slab (boxes), two lightning towers (lattice) with masts (cones)
Use known sizes for the rocket (published dimensions); measure the towers, whose sizes are not known
Each tower is one solid: a lofted square frustum shell with triangular X-brace windows cut through all four faces
Front orthographic IMAGE_FRAME at 246 mm/px, origin at the rocket base
